}}'''Somara''' was an [[Aiel]] ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]''. She treated [[Rand al'Thor]] as a son. 

== Appearance ==
She was very tall, just about as tall as Rand with blond hair.

==History==
She is of the [[Bent Peak]] [[Daryne]] Aiel.

She is a terrible cook.

== Activities ==
She was one of the Maidens who surrounded Rand when he met the nobles in [[Cairhien]] after the battle with the [[Shaido]]. She was also one of the Maidens who went to the battle in [[Caemlyn]] to fight [[Rahvin]]'s forces.

She was not impressed with the amount of affection Rand showed [[Min Farshaw]] when Min first arrived in Caemlyn.
She accompanied Rand when he Travels to Caemlyn after he had been captured by the [[White Tower]] [[Aes Sedai]].

She, along with the rest of the [[Maidens of the Spear]], was furious at being left behind during Rand al'Thor's campaign's against [[Illian]] and the [[Seanchan]]. Because the Maidens think of Rand as a first-brother, she beat him up as punishment when he returned to Cairhien. When the rogue [[Asha'man]] blow up Rand's quarters, she was on guard duty and perished.
